statement: RiemannHypothesis → (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor (Real.sqrt X/(Real.log (2+(X:ℝ)))^5); let A := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor ((X:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)); let c := fun (d : ℕ) => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d; let strip := fun (X : ℕ) => (((w X).filter Nat.Prime).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => A X < d ∧ d ≤ D X)).sum c)))/(X:ℝ); Filter.Tendsto strip Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0060 · 在同一窄窗把立方根到近平方根的带符号除数和压到零
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0060 · Show that the signed divisor strip from the cube root to the new cutoff tends to zero

brief.zh: 两个截点都趋于无穷，最终 D≥A。TP-0034 的两个截断主项同收敛到 2C₂/50，TP-0059 控制实际进程误差。由此把 TP-0038 的剩余分析移到 d>D，保留其原尺度和余量。
brief.en: Both cutoffs tend to infinity and D≥A eventually. TP-0034 gives the same 2C₂/50 limit at each cutoff. TP-0059 controls the actual progression errors. This moves the analysis in TP-0038 to d>D at the original scale and margin.
